express_bind.needs_auth_description: Sign in to Multica to complete the link. The token in the link binds your eXpress account to this Multica user, so you must be logged in first.
express_bind.done_description: Your next message to the bot in eXpress will go straight to the agent. You can close this tab.
express_bind.error_admin_hint: If this keeps happening, message the bot again in eXpress to get a fresh link.
express_bind.error_missing_token: The link is missing its token. Message the bot again in eXpress to get a new one.
express_bind.error_expired: This link is invalid or expired (links are valid for 15 minutes). Message the bot again to get a new one.
express_bind.error_already_bound: This eXpress account is already linked to a different Multica user. Account transfers must go through an explicit unbind first.
express_bind.error_not_member: You're signed in to a Multica account that isn't a member of this workspace.
express_bind.error_unknown: Something went wrong. Try again, and if the problem persists, contact the workspace admin.
